statusMeaning.passing: An automated gate exists and passes. Every listed evidence file is verified to exist.
statusMeaning.failing: The requirement is known not to be met, from a failing gate or a recorded code-level finding.
statusMeaning.pending: No automated gate and no established verdict. The honest default.
statusMeaning.not-applicable: The gate cannot apply to this component; the note argues why.

gates.title: Keyboard behavior
gates.criterion: Every interactive affordance is operable from the keyboard alone, proven by dispatching real key events (not synthetic clicks) and asserting the resulting state change.

gates.title: Screen-reader semantics
gates.criterion: Roles, accessible names, state (pressed/checked/expanded/selected), and live regions are asserted on the rendered shadow tree.

gates.title: Focus restoration
gates.criterion: A state-driven re-render preserves the active element and, for text fields, the caret/selection range — asserted, not assumed from the shared setShadowHtml() helper.

gates.title: Reduced motion
gates.criterion: Any animation the component owns, whether CSS or a programmatic camera move, is suppressed or shortened under prefers-reduced-motion.

gates.title: High contrast / forced colors
gates.criterion: The component remains legible and its state remains distinguishable under forced-colors: active and prefers-contrast: more.

gates.title: Responsive layout
gates.criterion: The component adapts to its container across the supported width range without clipping content or forcing horizontal overflow.

gates.title: Localization
gates.criterion: Every user-visible string is externalized and resolvable through an injectable message source; no user-visible literal is hard-coded in the render template.

gates.title: Pseudo-locale expansion
gates.criterion: Rendering under an accented/expanded pseudo-locale neither truncates nor overflows any label, proving the layout tolerates real translation growth.

gates.title: Right-to-left
gates.criterion: Under dir=rtl the component mirrors correctly, using logical properties rather than physical left/right offsets.

gates.title: Visual regression
gates.criterion: A committed reference screenshot is compared per release, so unintended visual change fails CI.

gates.title: Strict CSP
gates.criterion: The component renders and functions under a strict Content-Security-Policy with no 'unsafe-inline' for script or style, producing no CSP violation reports.

gates.title: Zero console error
gates.criterion: Mounting, driving, and unmounting the component emits no console.error or console.warn and raises no uncaught exception.

gates.title: Deterministic disposal
gates.criterion: Disconnecting the element releases every subscription, listener, timer, and in-flight request it created, asserted by observing the collaborator's listener count drop to zero.

gates.title: No duplicate listeners
gates.criterion: Repeated re-renders do not accumulate handlers: a single user interaction after N renders still produces exactly one event.

gates.title: Memory retention
gates.criterion: A mounted-then-removed element is not retained, proven by a WeakRef/heap-retention probe after the controller is released.

gates.title: SSR-safe import
gates.criterion: The owning entrypoint imports cleanly with no DOM globals present, defining no custom element and touching no browser API at module scope.

gates.title: Secure export contract
gates.criterion: Snapshot and state export actions fail closed without an explicit adapter, sanitize state and adapter output, preserve required provenance, and release adapter-owned resources exactly once; the built-in browser-print action is the documented safe exception.

gates.title: Per-entrypoint bundle budget
gates.criterion: The owning kit's entrypoint carries a declared byte ceiling in bundle-budgets.json, enforced by npm run verify:bundle-budgets, and is forbidden from statically retaining a renderer, PDF writer, image encoder, localization framework, or test-only peer.

console.error and console.warn are spied for the whole mount / drive / re-render / unmount cycle and asserted never to be called. Each covered web component is mounted and disconnected while console.error and console.warn are spied; the complete lifecycle emits neither.
Removing the element drops its controller state subscription and its root honua-controller-ready listener to zero, and a subsequent controller update reaches no detached element.

After ten controller-driven re-renders a single interaction still produces the same (non-zero) number of events it did after the first render, proving handlers are bound to freshly rendered nodes rather than accumulated on surviving ones.
Chromium's HeapProfiler.collectGarbage is used with a WeakRef for every catalog component; after removal and repeated forced collections, no detached element remains reachable.

Both kit entrypoints, the element module, the catalog, and the registry are imported in a DOM-free Node environment with window and document asserted absent; no custom element is defined and no browser global is touched at module scope.
This component does not expose print, renderer snapshot, or sanitized state export actions; the secure export contract is owned by honua-print-export.

The owning kit's entrypoint (/controls or /web-components) carries a declared min+gzip ceiling enforced by npm run verify:bundle-budgets, with maplibre-gl, cesium, deck.gl, PDF/image encoders, and localization frameworks declared as forbidden static inputs (NFR-001).
